summary: Backend auth/privacy/market regression passed (11/11) with seeded synthetic users. Frontend authenticated run reproduced a critical React Native runtime render error ('Unexpected text node') that blocks deeper UI flow testing.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime error repeatedly thrown: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>'. Error surfaces in Home.tsx (around return block) and ui.tsx Sheet rendering, causing Expo error overlay/toast and blocking normal navigation/testing.

integration_issues.flow: Authenticated dashboard -> location picker -> market navigation
integration_issues.issue: Synthetic session injection worked and manual location search (Pune) updated header location, but repeated runtime render errors prevented reliable progression to listing create/request flows.

react_native_issues.issue: Text node placement violation in web preview render path (RN rule: raw text must be within Text).

action_items: Fix the 'Unexpected text node' runtime issue in authenticated screens/components (Home.tsx and shared ui.tsx/Sheet path) before further UI validation.

After fix, retest requested mobile flows at 390x844 and 375x667: market listing create/request/accept/cancel, work board two-way interest, assistant send tap without force, diary/crop regression, signout/401 stale-session behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend currently violates RN text rendering constraints during authenticated use, producing repeated runtime errors in Expo preview.

Backend auth/session/privacy controls are strong in tested paths: 401 on missing/invalid/expired token, owner-only data scoping, request/accept conflict handling and overlap booking protection all validated.

success_rate.frontend: 30% (auth injection + location selection verified; critical runtime error blocked remaining flows)

seed_data_creation: Created synthetic Mongo test users/sessions for API and UI testing: TEST_user_owner_api, TEST_user_renter_api, TEST_user_outsider_api, plus temporary UI users TEST_user_ui_owner and TEST_user_ui_other.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not proceed with deeper UI assertions until runtime text-node error is fixed. Session injection key works via localStorage JSON under 'krushi_session' (and common AsyncStorage key variants). Manual location search Pune succeeded and header location updated.
rca_of_issue: Repro: Inject valid synthetic session -> authenticated home renders -> open/close location picker and continue navigating. Console/expo logs repeatedly show 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' with stack pointing to src/screens/Home.tsx and src/ui.tsx (Sheet). This runtime render issue destabilizes screen interactions and blocks marketplace flow tests.
